understanding.purpose: 帮助读者查找上海门店，并确认地址、联系电话和营业时间。
understanding.reading: 读者通常先按门店名称定位，再沿同一行查看地址、电话和营业时间；比较门店时也可能纵向浏览营业时间。
groups: 门店与地址共同确定到访地点，名称是行的识别入口，地址是主要的详细信息。
电话与营业时间都是到访前的实用信息，适合并列浏览。
keep_intact: 电话号码应保持在同一行，便于识别和拨打。
地址中的楼层、铺位等标识以及营业时间中的时间数字应尽量保持完整。
may_wrap: 地址较长，可在自然位置换行；地址换行形成的行高也可容纳同一行中门店名称或营业时间的换行。
门店名称和营业时间可以换行，但应避免拆散难以辨认的标识或时间数字。

preferred.name: r2B
preferred.note: 在 r1B 与 r1A 之间调整门店和地址的比例，尝试减轻门店名称的孤字断行，同时保留较宽的地址列。

acceptable.name: r1B
acceptable.note: 在r0A和r0B之间折中，给地址多19px，同时保留比r0B更宽的门店列；检验地址换行改善是否足以抵消少数较长门店名称可能换行的代价。

acceptable.name: r2A
acceptable.note: 将门店列增至 144px，尝试让最长门店名称保持单行；保留电话和营业时间的单行宽度，其余空间用于地址，观察地址断行是否仍自然。

acceptable.name: r2C
acceptable.note: 给门店名称更多余量，强化行识别入口；以更窄的地址列换取名称完整，检验地址是否仍能在自然位置断成不超过两行。

acceptable.name: r3C
acceptable.note: 从门店列移出4px给地址，测试名称是否仍能自然换行，以及较小的地址增宽是否能改善铺位标识断行。

bad.name: r1C
bad.note: 门店列保留完整名称所需宽度，营业时间列按88px单行内容宽度略作压缩，将余量交给地址；检验时间是否仍完整，以及地址换行能否更自然。
bad.why: Every opening-hours range breaks across two lines, separating the opening and closing times and making comparisons harder.

bad.name: r3A
bad.note: 保留门店名称和电话的单行宽度，从营业时间列移出10px给地址，观察能否减少地址末尾孤字；同时检查营业时间换行是否仍能保持时间数字完整。
bad.why: Every opening-hours range breaks across two lines; the extra address width does not compensate for the loss of a compact, scannable time column.

bad.name: r3B
bad.note: 从营业时间列移出5px给地址，尝试在改善地址断行与保持营业时间易读之间取得平衡。
bad.why: Every opening-hours range breaks across two lines, while the address column still leaves a single character on the second line in one row.

rationale: r2B gives the address column enough room for two shorter addresses to stay on one line, while keeping all telephone numbers and opening-hours ranges intact. Two store names wrap, but their rows remain easy to follow and the first store name fits on one line. The wider store column in r2A keeps every store name intact, though it leaves isolated address characters on two lines and makes every data row taller.

general: Give columns width according to their content and role in scanning, rather than making them equal.
Keep compact values such as telephone numbers and time ranges together when readers need to compare them quickly.
Judge wrapping by where lines break and how rows read, not by table height alone.
specific: At 109 px, the opening-hours column keeps all shown ranges on one line; the 105 px and narrower candidates wrap them.
The 347 px address column in r2B keeps two addresses on one line, while a 333 px column leaves isolated final characters in those rows.

tradeoffs: r2A gives every store name a single line and produces a uniform row rhythm, at the cost of narrower addresses and two isolated characters. r1B gives addresses slightly more room but wraps an additional store name.
uncertain: The ranges are conservative single-point estimates: the supplied renders do not establish how far widths can move while preserving the same line breaks and visual quality. A designer who prioritizes unbroken store names over address wrapping could reasonably prefer r2A.

critique.good: 门店名称、电话号码和营业时间均保持单行，行识别清楚，电话与时间也便于纵向浏览。地址占据主要宽度，两行地址与其他信息的行高协调。
critique.problems: 部分地址的第二行只剩一个字，或将楼层数字与“层”分开，读起来不够连贯。
critique.cause: 地址列为333px，可用文本宽度312px；门店列为144px，足以容纳最长名称，但余量不能用于地址。

critique.good: 地址列更宽，部分地址可保持单行，铺位信息总体更容易阅读；电话和营业时间仍保持单行。
critique.problems: 多数门店名称被拆成两行，有的第二行只有“店”，削弱了作为行识别入口的清晰度；部分地址仍在楼层标识附近换行。
critique.cause: 门店列缩至110px，可用文本宽度89px，不足以容纳较长名称；增加地址宽度也未能消除所有不理想的换行。

critique.good: 门店名称与电话号码保持单行，较宽的地址列让部分地址更完整。
critique.problems: 营业时间表头和所有时间范围都换成两行，表头因此变高，时间也更难纵向比较；部分地址仍拆开楼层标识。
critique.cause: 营业时间列仅71px，可用文本宽度50px，不足以容纳表头和完整时间范围；地址列371px仍不足以让所有地址在理想位置换行。

critique.good: 门店、地址和实用信息的层级清楚；电话和营业时间均保持单行，便于沿行查找和纵向比较。
critique.problems: 所有数据行都占两行，但部分地址只在第二行留下一个字，如“铺”或“室”，造成零碎的行尾；两个门店名称也把末尾的“店”单独留在第二行。
critique.cause: 地址列 337px 不足以容纳部分完整地址或更平衡的断行；门店列 140px 又不足以容纳最长的名称。

critique.good: 352px 的地址列让两条地址保持单行，避免了 r1A 的孤字行尾；电话和营业时间仍保持完整，表格节奏较紧凑。
critique.problems: 多个门店名称断行，首行名称末尾的“店”单独落在第二行，削弱了作为行识别入口的名称；其余长地址仍有楼层或铺位信息跨行的情况。
critique.cause: 为地址增加宽度后，门店列缩至 125px；地址列虽然更宽，仍不足以让所有长地址完整显示。

critique.good: 地址列比 r1A 稍宽，部分地址的断行得到改善；电话保持单行。
critique.problems: 所有营业时间都在时间范围中间换行，使原本适合纵向比较的一列变得零碎，并让本可单行的记录也变高；两个长门店名称仍有孤字行尾。
critique.cause: 营业时间列仅 105px，可用文字宽度不足以容纳完整时间范围；门店列 140px 仍不足以容纳最长名称。

critique.good: 门店名称、电话和营业时间均保持单行，读者可以迅速定位门店并横向查阅；地址占据主要宽度，六个等高数据行也形成稳定节奏。
critique.problems: 多处地址在楼层或铺位标识附近断行，例如“502”与“铺”、“B1-15”与“室”分开；第二行有时只剩一个字，显得零碎。
critique.cause: 地址列为333px，可用文本宽度约312px，尚不足以容纳这些地址的完整末尾。

critique.good: 347px的地址列让部分地址保持单行，也改善了一些地址末尾的完整性；电话和营业时间仍清楚地保持单行。
critique.problems: 两个较长门店名的“店”被挤到下一行，削弱了作为行识别入口的名称；部分楼层标识仍跨行，行高变化也使表格节奏较不均匀。
critique.cause: 门店列缩至130px，可用文本宽度约109px，小于最长名称的123px；增加的地址宽度仍不足以让所有长地址完整单行。

critique.good: 门店名称、电话和营业时间都保持单行，地址的多行排布和统一行高使各行边界清楚。
critique.problems: 门店列比容纳最长名称所需更宽，地址列因而更窄；地址末尾仍有“铺”“室”等孤字，部分楼层标识也被拆开。
critique.cause: 门店列150px比最长名称及内边距所需的144px多6px，使地址列缩至327px。

review.method: two fresh-context blind reviews; letters shuffled; includes browser auto layout and equal widths as neutral references

r2A.why: Store names, phone numbers and hours stay on one line, making rows easy to scan. The narrower address column leaves a few isolated final characters on second lines.

ref_equal.why: The address column is cramped into three or four lines while the phone and hours columns have substantial unused space. The tall rows slow comparison.

ref_auto.why: The wider addresses come at the cost of wrapping every phone number and every hours range, as well as several store names. These repeated breaks make comparison harder.

r1C.why: Phone numbers remain intact and addresses have room, but every hours range breaks across two lines and two store names wrap.

r1B.why: Phone numbers and hours remain intact, and the address column is reasonably generous. Three store names wrap, weakening the row labels slightly.

r2B.why: Phone numbers and hours remain intact, and most addresses use one or two lines. Two longer store names wrap, including a lone final character.

raw.unsure: A preserves every store name but produces less graceful address breaks than F; the choice depends on how much priority readers give to scanning store names versus reading addresses.

r1B.why: Addresses have generous space, and phone numbers and hours stay on one line. Several store names wrap, including one with a lone final character.

r2B.why: Phone numbers and hours remain intact, while most addresses fit in one or two lines. Two store names end with an isolated 店 on a second line.

ref_equal.why: Equal column widths leave excessive space around phone numbers and hours while forcing every address onto three lines, sometimes splitting address components awkwardly.

ref_auto.why: Every phone number and opening-hours range breaks across lines, making both columns difficult to scan and compare; several store names also wrap.

r1C.why: Phone numbers remain intact, but every opening-hours range splits across two lines, and two store names end with an isolated 店.

r2A.why: Store names, phone numbers and opening hours all stay intact on one line. Addresses have enough room for mostly readable two-line entries, although a few end with a single character.

raw.unsure: F leaves isolated final characters in a couple of addresses; whether that is preferable to wrapped store names in B involves a modest typographic tradeoff.

provenance.note: AI visual design judgement; not a human reading study
